title: StarterKit+
description: Adds a /starter command one time per player
body:
# StarterKit+
**by StarSMP Developement**

This plugin adds a simple /starter command to collect a starterkit!

## Supported Version
**1.21.1 - 1.21.11**


**This plugin is made by the Developement from the server xStarSMP.de**
**Join our Discord**: https://www.discord.gg/EcWcWMb9wr
